name: Wi-Fi Trainer Bridge
description: Drives a Wi-Fi Wahoo Kickr from Biketerra over the WFTNP protocol: feeds the trainer's real power & cadence into the game, and relays resistance control (erg / sim) to the Kickr. Host & port are configurable.

settings.label: Kickr IP address
settings.description: The Wi-Fi IP address of the Kickr (shown in the Wahoo Fitness app, or via `avahi-browse _wahoo-fitness-tnp._tcp` on the same network).

settings.label: WFTNP port
settings.description: Kickr Wi-Fi (WFTNP) TCP port. A verified-working client for this exact Kickr used 36866 (Wahoo's spec default). The unit also advertises a separate _zwift-protocol socket, observed on 36867 — not WFTNP. If 36866 refuses, the bridge automatically falls back to 36867.

settings.label: Bluetooth names to keep auto-pair away from
settings.description: Comma-separated Bluetooth device names the platform must never hand to the game while this bridge is the trainer — they are excluded from the in-ride 'pair device' auto-pair and chooser. Defaults to the Kickr's factory BT name so the same physical unit isn't also connected over Bluetooth. Heart rate straps, power meters and anything else named differently are unaffected.
